Applications

Where gesture control becomes operational.

The core system is designed to slot into different environments while keeping the same sleek interaction model: direct, low-friction, and hardware-light.

Application 1

Hands-free workstation control for situations where the operator must stay focused on movement, safety, or sterile handling.

  • Rapid setup with a standard webcam.
  • Gesture-to-command mapping for software tools and workflows.
  • Reduced dependency on extra peripherals.

Application 2

Embedded and custom device interfaces that need clean control logic without a noisy physical control surface.

  • Designed to adapt to product-specific interaction models.
  • Useful for kiosks, demos, and specialized equipment.
  • Modern visual layer that matches technical hardware products.
